Initial release of the "browser" skill for natural language browser automation via CLI:

- Automates web browser interactions for browsing, navigation, data extraction, screenshots, form-filling, and more.
- Supports both local Chrome and remote Browserbase sessions with anti-bot stealth, CAPTCHA solving, and residential proxies.
- Provides a full command set for page interaction, session management, and state inspection using the `browse` CLI.
- Includes best practices, troubleshooting tips, and clear guidance on when to select local vs remote mode.
- Ideal for scraping protected sites, bypassing bot detection, and interacting with JavaScript-heavy pages.
